name: En Gannim
overview: En Gannim is identified in Scripture as a city belonging to both the tribe of Judah and the tribe of Issachar, as reflected in the listings of towns in Joshua 15:34 and Joshua 19:21. It is mentioned alongside other cities within these tribal allotments, demonstrating its significance in the territorial divisions given by God to His people. Additionally, Joshua 21:29 highlights En Gannim as a Levitical city with its surrounding suburbs, underscoring its role in the religious and communal life of Israel.
